fast.why: Monday is the day deeds are presented to Allah and the day the Prophet ﷺ was born. Intend the night before; today is Jumaat, so don't single out Friday alone for fasting.

blessing: Weekend rest: a Saturday with no alarm is a gift many people don't get. Today, thank Allah out loud for the rest, and say Alhamdulillah after your first meal.

verse.text: For indeed, with hardship comes ease. Indeed, with hardship comes ease.

hadith.text: The Prophet ﷺ prayed at night until his feet swelled. Asked why, he replied: "Should I not be a grateful servant?"

lesson.title: Daily duas: before sleeping
lesson.text: The Prophet ﷺ would say when going to bed: "Bismika Allahumma amutu wa ahya" (In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live). On waking: "Alhamdulillahilladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilaihin-nushur" (Praise be to Allah who gave us life after causing us to die, and to Him is the resurrection). Say them tonight; each sleep is a small reminder that your life is a loan.

name.meaning: The Trustee, the Disposer of Affairs
name.text: "Sufficient for us is Allah, and He is the best Disposer of affairs" (3:173). Do your part on your caseload, then hand over the rest to Him.
"My mercy encompasses all things" (7:156). Tonight, remember you are held by a mercy wider than your worries.

world.text: Bulletin of the Atomic Scientists set it at 85 seconds to midnight on 27 Jan 2026, the closest ever, citing nuclear risk, AI and great-power rivalry.
Forecasters' chance of a 'World War Three' before 2050 (10M+ deaths, major powers involved).
Prof Jiang's latest lectures on geopolitics and where great-power conflict is heading.

Nuclear deterrence makes all-out war a losing move for every major power, so the stable outcome (flashing) is 'compete, don't fight': trade wars, arms races and proxy conflicts. The real danger is a misread in a crisis like Taiwan or Ukraine, which is why the clock and the forecast are rising. Meter: 2 of 5.
world.note: My own illustrative model, not a forecast from a source.
